summary: Iteration 4 focused on FORGE V2 P0 features. Ran 10 pytest backend cases (techniques catalog + bootstrap inclusion, custom program POST/GET persistence, DELETE reverts to engine, /api/sets stores technique, /api/coach SSE streaming with V2 context, plus V1/V2 regressions). All 10 backend tests passed. Frontend Playwright flow on desktop 1400x900: demo Today loaded, Perfil showed the 3 action buttons, Program Builder Pro modal opened with day tabs + name + duration + technique dropdown + info modal; save persisted and Today reflected FORGE_PRO (manual) and new name; Workout tab showed technique badge and opened the workout technique detail modal with Como funciona/Protocolo/Quando usar sections; reset-program restored the automatic engine split. No blocking issues found.

issues: React dev-only console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by Emergent instrumentation wrapping {e.name} inside <option>. Not user visible; consider suppressing or moving text out of instrumentation wrapper if noise is undesired.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 348-line file mixing models, catalogs, and routes; splitting into modules (models.py, routes/*, data.py) would ease maintenance as V2 grows.
build_program computes muscle-map volume with an O(muscles * sessions * exercises) lookup; acceptable at current scale but consider caching an exercise index (dict by id) if catalog grows.
score_priority assumes assessment values may be dict or string but does not defend against list/None; add isinstance guard for None to avoid future 500s if legacy data slips in.
/api/custom-program POST returns program built from a possibly stale profile fetch immediately after update_one; acceptable due to Motor session semantics but worth verifying under load.
seed_data_creation: Created profile TEST_custom_prog_v4 (deleted after test), TEST_sets_tech_v4 with one set log, plus reused TEST_regression_* from prior iterations. Demo profile custom_program was created and then reset in the UI test — final state has demo without custom_program (engine mode).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite entrypoints: /app/backend/tests/test_forge_v2_iteration4.py covers all V2 P0 additions (techniques catalog, custom-program POST/DELETE, sets.technique field, /api/coach SSE). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests -v. Frontend UI flow uses viewport 1400x900; to bypass onboarding set localStorage.forge_onboarded=1 and remove forge_profile_id. Program Builder testids: program-builder-overlay, builder-name, builder-duration, builder-day-N, builder-technique-N, technique-info-N, save-program-button, reset-program-button. Workout technique testids: technique-badge-{exercise_id}-{index}, workout-technique-detail, close-technique-modal.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues in this run. Only a benign React hydration warning surfaced from dev instrumentation wrapping <option> text nodes in <span>; not present in production build.
